articles.description: Alec Bohm, a former first-round pick, had ups and downs with the Phillies, but he finished his tenure with 483 RBIs. Now, he's heading to Kansas City to play for the Royals.
articles.title: Report: Alec Bohm agrees to deal with Royals after seven seasons with Phillies

articles.description: Star reliever, Miller has a seat at the table as the MLBPA’s director of collective bargaining and strategic initiatives. He joined Phillies Extra to discuss the CBA and more.
articles.title: MLBPA’s Andrew Miller on baseball’s looming lockout, why the players oppose a salary cap, and more
